content: [Feishu 群「CI/CD 治理」 david Fri Mar 20 09:00 EST 2026] IMPORTANT UPDATE: The compile job rules I mentioned in the email thread were the OLD version. MR #445 has been merged. The new compile job rules are now: `if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'` (only default branch, NOT all branches). This supersedes the earlier information in the email — do NOT use the old rule. The updated build_updated.yml is now in the workspace.

CRITICAL: David's Update 2 supersedes the compile job rules from Update 1's email. OLD (from email / Update 1): `if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH'` (all branches)
NEW (from MR #445 / Update 2): `if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'` (default branch only)
For Q11 fix: unit_test needs compile which now only runs on default branch. On feature branches / MR pipelines, compile is EXCLUDED → needs optional: true is required.
